teacher.policy_selection: None. Protocol fixes this architecture; do not read any final/global selected decoder or use inner heldout labels for decoder choice.
teacher.soft_targets: Softmax legal full-scene joint assignment energies divided by2, then marginalize to each current question's A/B/C/D options. Teacher sees permitted full-scene inputs; student does not. Teacher inputs remove answer/truth_word/target.
teacher.scope: 18 outer: each outer's three retained inner teachers generate only their heldout people's student-fitting softtargets. They exclude both the outer validation person and each softtarget person's labels. Matched outer teacher is evaluation-only. Final student uses three final-inner teachers.75 reused teacher checkpoints total; no final-allTrain teacher and no globalOOF shortcut.

student.input: Only current recording raw frozen sensor/generic descriptors plus4availability masks, current question text32D and each current option text128D deterministic signed SHA256 token/character hash. No peer recording, other question, recording position, acquisition/group/subject/QA/clip ID features. Path only retrieves current bank row.
student.architecture: raw3316+4mask to64 LayerNorm/tanh/dropout; current text to64 tanh/dropout; shared option dot interaction plus learned option-text bias. No option-letter embedding; argmax current options only.
student.normalization: Per-modality mean/std from this student's fitting people and available rows only; scale>=1e-4;clip10;missing zero. Same fitted normalizer A/B.
student.A: Official QA cross entropy only, same media/text inputs and model asB.
student.B: Official QA cross entropy plus1*temperature^2*KL(crossfit teacher joint marginal || student softmax(logits/temperature)).
student.matching: Identical initial state, per-scope RNG/dropout reset, deterministic epoch permutations and batch sizes; same60epochs and exact optimizer update count; no early stopping or outer-score selection.

validation: 18 heldout people plus final allTrain A/B. No parameter grid or selection; report fixed A/B and fixed teacher separately from historical full749. All18people historically observed. Original generic Kinetics and raw label-free features reused; no HARn-trained or KUNO upstream in this emotion teacher/student.
diagnostics: Paired by-person CI and per-person/missing-modality accuracy; official QA heldout only. Teacher in-scope crossfit scores are training-target reliability diagnostics, not globalOOF. Single-question, shuffled-ID/path, other-question deletion/poison, target/group/position poison and current-option permutation checks. Independent process reload verifies actual probabilities and model state. No Test/pseudo data or submissions.
